name: @mpd-dsh/agent-teams
description: Adopted @nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams (0.1.14 body, MIT) as a first-class main-code package, with the audited 0.1.16-rc.3 upstream deltas backported: the Harness subagent boundary (host FIFO queue delivery, sync member setup, retired-member guard), agent-scoped capabilities (member instructions + captain-tool denial), tool-names, authenticated web routes, member turn-failure handling, and the durability fixes (settled team locks, blank optional task fields, captain claim guard). Server runtime closure vendored under _deps/ (see scripts/vendor-agent-teams.ts); the browser bundle is loaded by the web app via the mpd bundle's ./client export.
